title: Formally Dressed Middle-Aged Couple by Home, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a middle-aged couple dressed in formal 1940s attire, standing beside the stucco exterior of a residential home. The man wears a classic three-piece suit with a necktie and pocket square, gazing intently forward, while the woman wears a dark tailored skirt suit adorned with a prominent floral corsage at her collar. The photograph features decorative scalloped deckle edges characteristic of mid-20th-century home photography prints.
